meta.title: Last-PO details on a line: date formats and the vendor looked up by its padded code
gaps: No setup recipe creates lines with last-PO dates or vendor codes, including padded-code and inactive-vendor mappings.
No operation reads last-PO fields or a line report.
The available read_line_items operation requires eventGroupUuid and exposes no assertion fields for dates, vendor name/city, inactive vendors, or '-' placeholders.
